text: ООО «БК «Олимп», the licensed bookmaker operating the Olimpbet brand (olimp.bet), is 97.5% owned by ООО «Зевс» and 2.5% by its general director Sergey Kozyavkin, per EGRUL registry data republished by RusProfile.
short: Olimpbet's operator ООО «БК «Олимп» is 97.5% owned by ООО «Зевс» and 2.5% by CEO Sergey Kozyavkin.

source.name: RusProfile: ООО "БК "Олимп" company profile (EGRUL data, archived by the Wayback Machine)
source.quote: Основным владельцем выступает юридическое лицо ООО "ЗЕВС" с долей 97,5%, тогда как сам директор владеет 2,5% уставного капитала
source.note: Russian: the main owner is the legal entity ООО «Зевс» with a 97.5% share, while the director himself owns 2.5% of the charter capital. The live rusprofile.ru page blocks datacenter requests; the archived capture is from 2025-12-22. The page's founders section per EGRUL names ООО «Зевс» and Козявкин Сергей Геннадьевич as the two founders.

additionalSources.note: Undated evergreen review page; date is the day it was opened. Russian: since 2016 'Olimpbet' (ООО «БК «Олимп») legally accepts online bets — ties the Olimpbet brand to the legal entity ООО «БК «Олимп».
